## Conversation

### [**itayzrihan**](https://github.com/itayzrihan)commented[yesterday](https://github.com/vxu-labs/dip/pull/4#issue-5810328045)

**Show options**

**Member**

macOS writes binary AppleDouble files such as `._event.json` alongside real events on external volumes. DIP treated them as JSON events, blocking task preparation, checkpoints and completion with a corrupt-history error.

Skip `._` sidecars in the core and portable event readers and navigation index signatures. Real malformed event JSON still blocks mutations. Update the bundled portable helper and record the verified task evidence.

Validation: 46 core, portable and navigation tests passed, including three new regression cases; JavaScript syntax checks passed. Applied the same narrow fix to the local installation and successfully prepared and recorded the previously blocked Visu task.
